modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Your cabin bag may be taken at the gate and carried in the hold, then returned when you leave the aircraft.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: 1 cabin bag up to 55 cm x 40 cm x 20 cm, including handles and wheels.

carryon_weight.value: The cabin bag and accessory together may not exceed 10 kg; anything heavier is tagged and checked.

personal_item.value: 1 accessory (laptop in its sleeve, handbag, small backpack or schoolbag) that fits under the seat in front.

allowance.value: Checked baggage travels free in the hold, within the weight shown on your ticket (20 kg).

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are Twin Jet's own general conditions of carriage.

rebooking.value: If Twin Jet cancels a flight, operates it with excessive delay, misses your stop or makes you miss a connection on the same contract, it must, in agreement with you, carry you on another of its flights with space at no extra charge (extending the ticket if needed) or reroute you on its own or another carrier's services, or by surface transport.

refund.value: In those cases the refund is the fare paid if no part of the ticket has been used, or at least the difference between the fare paid and the fare for the unused part.

phone_home_market.notes: Listed with Twin Jet's flight-operations address in the footer of its own baggage page.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
